name: DIVE: A Multi-Label Smart Contract Vulnerability Dataset
independence_scope: independent research group and dataset pipeline
chronosaudit_role: external deployment/control sampling frame; detector-label triangulation
notes: 22,330 real-world contracts deployed 2016-2024; eight vulnerability labels. Public GitHub framework exposes address/data structure. Record-level risk-set qualification remains required.

name: Bastet: A Fine-Grained Expert-Labeled Dataset for DeFi Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
independence_scope: independent research group; two-annotator expert consensus
notes: 849 fully annotated findings from 4,402 Code4rena findings; two-annotator white-hat consensus. Exceeds 834-label count but does not label the same 417 ChronosAudit cases.

name: CyberChainBench
independence_scope: independent curator/manual benchmark construction; incident-source overlap with DeFiHackLabs
notes: 541 real-world exploit incidents across nine EVM chains with historical state and structured vulnerability ground truth. Useful third-party triangulation, not casewise ChronosAudit adjudication.

name: Re-Evaluating EVMBench (ReEVMBench)
notes: 22 real-world incidents postdating all evaluated model releases; 26 configurations; no end-to-end exploit success across 110 agent-incident pairs.

name: Smart Contract and DeFi Security Tools: Do They Meet the Needs of Practitioners?
notes: Five state-of-the-art tools evaluated on 127 high-impact attacks; only 8% of attacks judged preventable by the tools, all reentrancy-related.

name: Sourcify Database Export v2
notes: Daily Parquet exports; table files ordered by created_at; older full files are append-only/immutable; GCS metadata supplies ETag, size and timestamps; includes contract_deployments and verified_contracts.
